title: Loopress project configuration
description: Project-level config for the Loopress CLI (loopress.json).

rootDir.description: Base directory for all Loopress paths. All other path options are resolved relative to this directory.

snippetsDir.description: Directory where code snippets are read from and written to, relative to rootDir.

acfDir.description: Directory where ACF field groups, post types, taxonomies and options pages are read from and written to, relative to rootDir.

formDir.description: Directory where forms (WPForms today) are read from and written to, relative to rootDir.

apiDir.description: Directory where custom API route files are read from and written to, relative to rootDir.

blockDir.description: Directory of dynamic blocks, one <slug>/ folder holding block.json and render.php, registered as loopress/<slug>, relative to rootDir.

hooksDir.description: Directory where hook files (WordPress actions, filters, and scheduled tasks) are read from and written to, relative to rootDir.

appsDir.description: Directory where single-page app bundles are read from and written to, relative to rootDir. Each subdirectory is one app: a loopress.app.json plus a built dist/ folder.

pageDir.description: Directory where static HTML pages (one <slug>.html per WordPress page, managed by Loopress) are read from, relative to rootDir.

templateDir.description: Directory where block templates (one <slug>.html per template, written to the Loopress child theme of the active block theme) are read from, relative to rootDir. A static page uses one with its `template` header.

partDir.description: Directory where block template parts (one <slug>.html per part, written to the Loopress child theme of the active block theme) are read from, relative to rootDir.

cssDir.description: Directory of the theme's global CSS, relative to rootDir. Its style.css is the entry: it @imports the other files, bundled into the style.css of the Loopress child theme and loaded on every page.

blockCssDir.description: Directory of per-block CSS (one <namespace>/<block>.css per block, e.g. core/button.css), relative to rootDir. Each file is bundled into the Loopress child theme and only loaded on pages that render that block.

optionsDir.description: Directory where explicitly tracked WordPress options (wp_options rows) are read from and written to, relative to rootDir. Only options added via `lps option add` live here, this is never the whole options table.

cptDir.description: Directory where custom post types (one JSON file of register_post_type() arguments per post type, named <slug>.json) are read from and written to, relative to rootDir.

taxonomyDir.description: Directory where taxonomies (one JSON file of register_taxonomy() arguments plus "object_type" per taxonomy, named <slug>.json) are read from and written to, relative to rootDir.

roleDir.description: Directory where user roles (one JSON file of "name" and "capabilities" per role, named <slug>.json) are read from and written to, relative to rootDir.

patternDir.description: Directory where block patterns (one <slug>.html of block markup per pattern, registered as loopress/<slug>) are read from and written to, relative to rootDir.

metaDir.description: Directory where post meta keys (one JSON file per post type, named <post-type>.json, mapping each meta key to its register_post_meta() arguments) are read from and written to, relative to rootDir.

menuDir.description: Directory where nav menus (one JSON file per menu, plus menu-locations.json for the active theme's menu locations) are read from and written to, relative to rootDir.

themeStylesDir.description: Directory where the active block theme's Global Styles customizations (Site Editor > Styles: colors, typography, spacing) are read from and written to, relative to rootDir. Classic (non-block) themes are not supported.

projectId.description: Project identifier from the global Loopress config. When set, takes precedence over the currently active project in the global config.

plugins.description: WordPress.org plugins managed by Loopress, installed via Composer + WPackagist on the site. Keys are plugin slugs. A value is either an exact version to pin (e.g. "9.4.2") or "latest" to track the newest release on every push, and the plugin is kept active. An object with "active": false keeps the plugin installed but inactive. Removing an entry uninstalls the plugin on the next push. Ignored when a composer.json exists in rootDir (that file becomes authoritative).

active.description: false keeps the plugin installed but inactive. Defaults to true.

activateChildTheme.description: Keep the Loopress child theme (<parent>-loopress) active: `lps theme template push`, and so `lps push`, activates it when it isn't. Off by default, a theme switch changes the settings WordPress stores per theme.

themes.description: WordPress.org themes managed by Loopress, installed via Composer + WPackagist on the site. Keys are theme slugs; values are an exact version or "latest". Loopress manages installed theme versions only, it never switches the active theme (see activateChildTheme and `lps theme activate`). Ignored when a composer.json exists in rootDir.
